title: Bitmomo BTC Intelligence — Standardized Analyst Output (Reconciled V1)
description: Every one of the 11 analysts must emit exactly this shape so the consensus layer (docs/ai/CONSENSUS_DESIGN.md) can combine them mechanically. Reconciled 2026-08-26: added invalidation_price so per-analyst outcomes can be settled the same mechanical way class-bitmomo-ai-performance.php already settles the existing single signal's risk level (see docs/ai/VALIDATION_PLAN.md).

analyst_id.description: One of the 11 role ids from docs/ai/11_ANALYST_ROLES.md.

package_id.description: The input package_id this output was generated from -- links every output back to its exact input snapshot for historical replay.

confidence.description: Analyst's own self-reported confidence. Not adjusted for historical accuracy -- that adjustment happens in the consensus layer, not here.

key_drivers.description: Short, specific reasons -- not generic filler. 1-4 items expected.

invalidation.description: The specific condition that would prove this call wrong, in plain language. Required -- an analyst that can't state an invalidation condition shouldn't emit high confidence.

invalidation_price.description: Added by the 2026-08-26 reconciliation. Numeric price level matching the plain-language 'invalidation' field, so a per-analyst outcome tracker can mechanically check whether the level was breached -- the same pattern class-bitmomo-ai-performance.php already uses for the existing single signal's '_bm_outcome_risk_triggered' field. Null only when direction is NEUTRAL and no directional invalidation level applies.

data_quality_flag.description: Self-assessment of whether this analyst's specific input slice was complete and fresh enough to trust. An analyst running on the Bybit derivatives fallback (see derivatives.data_status in ANALYST_INPUT_SCHEMA.json) should generally report 'degraded', not 'good' -- the fallback exists precisely because the primary source failed for this run. "insufficient" should suppress this output's weight in the consensus layer almost entirely.

reasoning_summary.description: Short plain-language reasoning, capped in length deliberately.
